desc:
[✨UPD - Freeplay mode is now available on new servers!]
Welcome to Sew Off! 🧵 Design it, cut it, sew it, then strut it down the runway!

🗳️ Vote on a theme like Royal Ball, Beach Day, Galaxy Gala and dozens more!
✂️ Pick your patterns, lay out the fabric, and cut every piece yourself!
🪡 Pin it, sew it, and watch your dress come to life!
👠 Walk the runway beside your dress while everyone rates it!
🏆 Impress the judges and climb onto the podium!
🎀 Collect 100+ fabrics: silks, satins, florals, sparkly lamé and more!
🎁 Open crates, unlock new patterns, and claim your daily gifts!

Who will be the top designer on the runway?!
